about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Swedish Pickled Beetroot Salad
recipes.summary: Sliced beetroot in a sweet, sharp brine with red onion, a staple of the Swedish smorgasbord.
steps: Warm the vinegar, sugar, water, salt and bay leaf in a pan for 4 minutes, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Layer the beetroot and onion in a jar or bowl.
Pour over the warm brine and leave to cool before serving.
notes: Best after a few hours in the fridge.

recipes.title: Lithuanian Grated Beetroot Salad with Sour Cream
recipes.summary: Grated cooked beetroot with garlic, dill and sour cream, bright and tangy.
steps: Mix the sour cream, garlic, lemon juice and salt together in a bowl.
Fold the grated beetroot through the dressing until evenly coated and pink.
Scatter with the dill and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Danish Cauliflower Soup
recipes.summary: A smooth, buttery cauliflower and potato soup with a splash of milk.
steps: Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the cauliflower, potato and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are very tender.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the milk and nutmeg and warm for 2 minutes until hot.
notes: Use oil and oat milk for a dairy-free soup.
Check the stock label for gluten.

recipes.title: Nigerian Maize Pap Porridge
recipes.summary: A smooth, lightly sweet cornmeal porridge made with milk, a common family breakfast.
steps: Whisk the cornmeal with 1/2 cup of the cold water until no lumps remain.
Bring the rest of the water to the boil, then whisk in the cornmeal paste until smooth.
Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy, then stir in the milk and sugar.
notes: Add more water for a thinner pap.

recipes.title: Kenyan Uji Maize and Lemon Porridge
recipes.summary: A thin, tangy maize flour porridge with lemon and sugar, a warming Kenyan breakfast drink.
steps: Whisk the maize flour with 1/2 cup of the cold water until smooth.
Bring the remaining water to the boil, pour in the paste and whisk until smooth.
Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, until thickened and cooked through, then stir in the sugar, lemon juice and salt.

recipes.title: Antiguan Greens and Pumpkin Soup
recipes.summary: Spinach, pumpkin and sweet potato simmered with thyme and a little coconut milk.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the pumpkin, sweet potato, thyme and stock and simmer for 18 minutes until tender.
Add the spinach and coconut milk and cook for 3 minutes until the spinach is wilted, then blend roughly.
notes: Add a whole chilli while simmering for gentle heat.
Check the stock label for gluten.

recipes.title: Thai Suki Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: A sweet, sour and garlicky chilli dip with sesame, the classic partner to Thai hot pot.
steps: Whisk the sriracha, fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and peanut butter together until smooth.
Stir in the garlic, sesame seeds and coriander.
Spoon into small dipping bowls.

recipes.title: Taiwanese-Style Sesame Satay Hot Pot Dip
recipes.summary: A rich peanut, garlic and chilli oil dip for dunking hot pot meats and vegetables.
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and hot water together until smooth.
Stir in the sesame oil, chilli oil and garlic.
Scatter with the spring onions and serve in small bowls.
notes: Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Pacific Pineapple and Cucumber Salad
recipes.summary: Sweet pineapple, cool cucumber, chilli and lime topped with toasted coconut.
steps: Combine the pineapple, cucumber, chilli and mint in a bowl.
Pour over the lime juice and toss until coated.
Scatter with the coconut just before serving.
notes: Serve with grilled fish or chicken.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Sweet Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Tender sweet potato in a creamy rice vinegar dressing with spring onion, like a luau potato salad.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 to 15 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard and salt together.
Fold the sweet potato and spring onions through the dressing until coated.

recipes.title: Samoan Coconut Cabbage Salad
recipes.summary: Crisp cabbage with tomato, onion and a lime and coconut cream dressing.
steps: Combine the cabbage, tomato and onion in a bowl.
Whisk the coconut cream, lime juice and salt together.
Toss the dressing through the salad until the cabbage is coated.
notes: Serve straight away for the best crunch.

recipes.title: Tajik Radish and Onion Salad
recipes.summary: Sharp radish and red onion in a light dill and vinegar dressing, a crisp table salad for plov.
steps: Combine the radish, onion and dill in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and salt together.
Pour over the salad and toss until lightly coated.
notes: Soak the onion in cold water for a milder bite.

recipes.title: Peruvian Ocopa Peanut and Herb Sauce
recipes.summary: A creamy peanut, coriander and chilli sauce for boiled potatoes and grilled meats.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Blend with the peanuts, feta, milk, coriander and chilli until smooth.
Spoon over boiled potatoes or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Bolivian Llajwa Tomato and Chilli Salsa
recipes.summary: A fresh Andean salsa of tomato, chilli and coriander, served beside grilled meat and potatoes.
steps: Blend the tomato, chillies, coriander and garlic until finely chopped.
Stir in the oil and salt until combined.
Serve cool in a small bowl.
notes: Remove the chilli seeds for a milder salsa.

recipes.title: Alentejo Bread and Coriander Soup with Poached Egg
recipes.summary: A Portuguese peasant soup of garlic, coriander and bread softened in olive oil broth.
steps: Crush the garlic, coriander and salt to a paste.
Stir in the oil and boiling water and simmer for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Poach the eggs in the broth for 3 minutes until the whites are fully set.
Place the bread in bowls and ladle over the broth and eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.

recipes.title: Portuguese Tomato Rice Soup
recipes.summary: A light tomato soup with rice, garlic and parsley, simple Portuguese comfort.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, rice, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir through the parsley.
notes: Food safety: cool leftovers and refrigerate within 1 hour, then reheat until steaming hot.
Remove the bay leaf before serving.

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Migas Breakfast Fry-Up
recipes.summary: Crisp garlicky breadcrumbs fried with smoked paprika and chorizo, topped with a fried egg.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp and the fat has run.
Add the bread and garlic and cook for 6 minutes, tossing, until golden and crisp.
Stir in the paprika, push the migas aside and fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until it reaches 75°C and the egg whites are fully set.

recipes.title: Basque Piperade with Eggs
recipes.summary: Soft capsicum, tomato and onion stew with eggs scrambled through.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 10 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, paprika and tomato and simmer for 10 minutes until jammy.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set.

recipes.title: Dill Yoghurt Sauce for Grilled Salmon
recipes.summary: Cool, garlicky Greek yoghurt with dill, lemon and a touch of mustard.
steps: Stir the yoghurt, dill, lemon juice, garlic, mustard and salt together until smooth.
Taste and add more lemon if needed.
Spoon beside grilled salmon and finish with a little extra dill.

recipes.title: Pineapple Teriyaki Sauce
recipes.summary: A glossy pineapple, soy and ginger sauce for grilled chicken, pork and tofu.
steps: Simmer the pineapple juice, soy sauce, sugar, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until reduced a little.
Mix the cornflour with the water and stir in.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring, until glossy and thick.
notes: Food safety: if you used it to marinate raw meat, boil the sauce for 2 minutes before serving.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Charred Spring Onion Salsa for Grilled Meat
recipes.summary: Smoky charred spring onions chopped with olive oil, capers and parsley.
steps: Grill the spring onions on a hot barbecue or pan for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until charred and tender.
Chop roughly and mix with the oil, vinegar, capers, parsley and chilli flakes.
Spoon over grilled steak, lamb or chicken.
notes: Make it while the onions are warm so they soak up the dressing.

recipes.title: Lithuanian Bulviniai Blynai Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged grated potato pancakes with onion, fried golden and eaten with sour cream.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato in a clean tea towel to remove the liquid.
Mix with the onion, egg, flour and salt.
Fry spoonfuls in the oil for 4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centre is hot and the egg fully set.

recipes.title: Kyrgyz Beef and Cabbage Soup
recipes.summary: A plain, filling beef broth with potato, carrot, cabbage and dill.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil for 5 minutes until coloured, then add the onion and carrot for 4 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and stock and simmer for 35 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potato and cabbage and cook for 15 minutes until soft, then stir through the dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and the soup reaches 75°C; eat leftovers within 3 days.
Check the stock label for gluten.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Tuna and Onion Soup
recipes.summary: A lime-sharp tuna, potato and tomato soup finished with red onion and coriander.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the tomato and cumin.
Add the potato and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in the tuna and cook for 3 minutes until heated through, then add the lime juice and coriander.
notes: Food safety: keep the tuna chilled until use and eat leftovers within 2 days, reheating until steaming hot.
